verdict.rationale: The Literature agent searches 175M+ papers and can run deep reviews that synthesize evidence across hundreds of papers, with findings traceable to source passages. The client API can submit many tasks in batch and wait for them, so a researcher could script consistent queries across many items. However, nothing documents a systematic-review workflow such as inclusion/exclusion screening or structured per-paper extraction against fixed criteria; that would have to be built from generic task calls. Missing for 10: explicit screening with inclusion/exclusion criteria, structured per-paper data extraction or tabular output, documented reproducible consistent-criteria workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
